column1: # TwinLLM genome-synth variant catalog, version genome-synth-v1. SYNTHETIC USE ONLY.
# Public summary data only: identifiers, positions, alleles and allele frequencies as plain numbers. No individual-level data.
# Retrieved 2026-10-27 from the Ensembl REST API, release 116 (https://rest.ensembl.org; Ensembl data are free to use without restriction):
#   chrom/pos/ref: GRCh38 mapping of the dbSNP build 156 rsID (dbSNP, NCBI: public domain);
#   alt/alt_af: most frequent non-reference allele and its frequency in af_source: gnomADg:ALL = gnomAD genomes, all samples (gnomAD: CC0 1.0);
#     1000G-phase3:ALL = 1000 Genomes phase 3, all 2,504 samples (IGSR: free to use without restriction);
#   consequence: Ensembl's most severe Sequence Ontology consequence;
#   clinvar: ClinVar clinical significance as imported by Ensembl (ClinVar 09/2025, NCBI: public domain; cite ClinVar).
# Curated by hand: category, gene and note. Panel and pgx rsIDs are star-allele defining or annotated sites from public CPIC
#   allele definition tables (https://cpicpgx.org/guidelines/, CC0 1.0) and PharmGKB variant pages (https://www.pharmgkb.org/);
#   only the rsID and a short label are used, no PharmGKB annotation text.
# Refresh with: bun scripts/genome-synth/refresh-catalog.ts [--write]. Changing a row changes the genotypes of every subject at that site.
